en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Najran, from Aasim Bin Humeyd, from Muhammad Bin Qays, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I heard him<sup>asws</sup> saying, ‘
Divorce of the slave to the slave girls are two divorces, and her term is of two menstruation if she was menstruation. If she was not menstruating, so her term is a month and a half’.
